verdict.reasoning: This object describes one coherent overnight-range breakout/retest framework with direction chosen by context, not two co-required opposite trades. Its own wording makes the directional elements alternatives: first mark the overnight high/low, then wait for price to break either above or below the range, confirm the candle close, and take the matching retest setup—LONG only after a strong break above and bullish retest of the overnight high as support, or SHORT only after a weak break below and bearish retest of the overnight low as resistance. The precondition explicitly routes side selection by overall trend (uptrend favors longs above the range; weak/downtrend favors shorts below the range), so a single trade instance would execute one side or the other, not both simultaneously. Stops and management also remain side-consistent rather than contradictory.
